''[[Writers Guild of America West]] ceremony was cancelled on March 1'' |last=[[77th Writers Guild of America Awards|77th]] |next=79th }} The '''78th [[Writers Guild of America Awards]]''' were held on March 8, 2026, to honor the best writing in film, television and radio of 2025.{{cite news |publisher=THR Staff |title=Awards Season Calendar: Key Dates for Oscars, Emmys, Tonys, Grammys, Golden Globes and Other Major Events |url=https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/movies/movie-news/2025-2026-awards-season-calendar-oscars-emmys-dates-1235872190/ |access-date=January 6, 2026 |work=[[The Hollywood Reporter]] |date=September 18, 2025}} The nominations were announced on January 27, 2026.{{cite web |title=2026 Writers Guild Awards Nominees |url=https://awards.wga.org/awards/nominees-winners |website=Writers Guild Awards |access-date=28 January 2026}}{{cite web|last=Zee|first=Michaela|title=Writers Guild Awards Nominations: ‘Sinners,’ ‘Marty Supreme’ and ‘One Battle After Another’ Among the Nominees |url=https://variety.com/2026/film/news/writers-guild-awards-2026-nominations-1236642509/|date=January 27, 2026|access-date=January 27, 2026|website=[[Variety (magazine)|Variety]]}} [[Roy Wood Jr.]] returned to host for the New York ceremony at the [[Edison Theatre|Edison Ballroom]].{{Cite web |last=ttimmerberg |date=2026-01-28 |title=2026 Writers Guild Awards: New York Ceremony Host and Presenters Announced {{!}} Press Room |url=https://www.wgaeast.org/2026-writers-guild-awards-2026-writers-guild-awards-new-york-ceremony-host-and-presenters-announced/ |access-date=2026-03-08 |website=Writers Guild of America East}} The 78th Awards took place amid the [[2026 Writers Guild Staff Union Strike]]. The Writers Guild Staff Union represents over 110 employees of the Writers Guild of America West. On March 1, the Los Angeles ceremony was cancelled after the WGSU refused to ratify the WGAW's last best and final offer by February 27. The East ceremony in New York City continued as planned. ==WGAW Ceremony Cancellation== {{Main|2026 Writers Guild Staff Union Strike}} [[File:Atsuko Okatsuka at WGSU Benefit Show.jpg|thumb|Okatsuka performs jokes intended for the cancelled 78th WGAW Awards for an audience of striking WGSU members and donors on Sunday, March 8, 2026]] In February 2026, the staff of the Writers Guild of America West, who have been bargaining with Guild Management over a first union contract, went on [[2026 Writers Guild Staff Union Strike|an unfair labor practice strike]], alleging that the Guild had committed unionbusting and bad faith "surface bargaining". On February 24, Guild Management threatened to shut down the awards show the following month if the Writers Guild Staff Union (WGSU) did not accept their last, best, and final offer by February 27.{{Cite web |last=Maddaus |first=Gene |date=2026-02-24 |title=WGA Staff Strike Enters Second Week as Writers Guild Awards Could Be Nixed |url=https://variety.com/2026/film/news/wga-staff-strike-second-week-two-sides-meet-1236671991/ |access-date=2026-02-25 |website=Variety |language=en-US}} The staff union refused to entertain the offer, criticizing it for lacking "basic union protections" and for "maintaining status quo". On February 28, the day after the Guild promised to cancel the Awards, they had still not publicly announced a cancellation. The WGSU said they remained ready to continue bargaining with the Guild's management once they returned to the table.{{Cite web |date=2026-02-27 |title=Writer's Guild Awards could be canceled |url=https://www.2news.com/news/national/writers-guild-awards-could-be-canceled/video_c4e5d13d-3f2c-5094-83e0-5eb96efefa3c.html |access-date=2026-02-28 |website=2 News Nevada |language=en}} On March 1, Writers Guild of America West (WGAW) cancelled the Los Angeles ceremony planned for March 8. The show was scheduled to take place at the [[JW Marriott Hotels|JW Marriott Los Angeles L.A. LIVE]] and be hosted by comedian and WGAW member [[Atsuko Okatsuka]].{{Cite web |title=Writers Guild of America West Cancels Los Angeles Awards Show |url=https://www.wga.org/news-events/news/press/wgaw-cancels-los-angeles-awards-show |access-date=2026-03-08 |website=www.wga.org}} After the awards show cancellation, Okatsuka announced on March 6 that she would be headlining a Benefit Comedy Show for the striking workers instead. In a quote to ''The Hollywood Reporter'', Okatsuka said, "I'm a union girl... We're only as strong as the people behind the scenes!! We're one unit, so we must move as such. I was supposed to host the awards this Saturday. A day of celebrating the hard work of artists in one of the strongest unions in the U.S.. But could we really celebrate while the staff, who help support the union are asking to be heard of their needs? I'm honored to stand with them."{{cite web |last1=Kilkenny |first1=Katie |title=Would-Be Writers Guild West Awards Host Atsuko Okatsuka Set to Headline Fundraiser for Striking Staff |url=https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/business/business-news/former-wga-awards-host-headline-fundraiser-striking-staff-1236523277/ |website=The Hollywood Reporter |access-date=8 March 2026 |date=6 March 2026}} == Winners and Nominees == Winners are listed first in boldface.{{cite web |title=2026 Writers Guild Awards Nominees & Winners |url=https://awards.wga.org/awards/nominees-winners |access-date=10 March 2026}} === Film === {{Table vertical alignment}} {| class="wikitable defaulttop" |- | style="width:50%;"| {{Award category|{{WGA Awards/color}}|[[Writers Guild of America Award for Best Original Screenplay|Best Original Screenplay]]}} * '''''[[Sinners (2025 film)|Sinners]]'' – [[Ryan Coogler]]''' ** ''[[Black Bag]]'' – [[David Koepp]] ** ''[[If I Had Legs I'd Kick You]]'' – [[Mary Bronstein]] ** ''[[Marty Supreme]]'' – [[Ronald Bronstein]] & [[Josh Safdie]] ** ''[[Weapons (2025 film)|Weapons]]'' – [[Zach Cregger]] | style="width:50%;"| {{Award category|{{WGA Awards/color}}|[[Writers Guild of America Award for Best Adapted Screenplay|Best Adapted Screenplay]]}} * '''''[[One Battle After Another]]'' – [[Paul Thomas Anderson]];
